Hi Emma — thanks for the intake and the context. We can handle this. High level workflow we follow for these requests:

1) Intake validation (confirm exact conversation IDs or a time-range + account ID)
2) Validation & freeze (snapshot for audit; prevents further writes to the objects)
3) Execution (expunge job across primary stores + ephemeral caches)
4) Verification (hash checks and handoff to compliance engineer)
5) Signed audit packet (manifest.csv + signed PDF)

Typical timeline for cases scoped to a single account is 3–7 business days after intake validation. For full production, we aim to keep execution within a single maintenance window.

Actions for GreenBank: please attach the full list of conversation IDs if you have them; otherwise we will run a scoped query using the account/time window you provided and share the candidate list for your approval before deletion.

I attached the removal intake you sent (removal_request_form.csv) and a short checklist we use. I’ve looped Rishi and Neha to own the execution and verification.

If the scope is limited to the US region (as you requested), we will execute on US-hosted storage only and include that in the signed proof.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Lead — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Emma / Marissa — quick technical summary of how we'll execute and what the audit will include.

Execution summary (high level):
- We will run an expunge job that touches three layers: primary object store (S3-like), inference logs (Kafka/stream archive snapshots), and short-term KV/prefix caches on serving nodes.
- For model-derived artifacts (embeddings/metadata), we will remove associated lookup entries and rotate any derived keys.
- We will not roll back model weights or training data (this is scoped to runtime artifacts only).

Verification & artifacts:
- removal_manifest.csv: line-item list of object IDs (object path), removed_at timestamp (ISO), and storage region tag.
- audit_proof_greenbank_signed.pdf: compliance-ready PDF with a summary, signed by our compliance engineer, and a SHA256 manifest hash to verify integrity.
- operation logs: ephemeral job logs are kept for 90 days; the signed PDF will reference the job run id for traceability.

Estimated timeline: intake validation + approval today (same-day). Execution tomorrow or by Wednesday (2027-03-31) depending on approvals; signed audit packet delivered within 24 hours after execution.

I'll start the scoped query now using the account/timeframe and produce a candidate list for your confirmation.

--Rishi
